desc: helper program for importing a crl to the NSS database
r: ipsec__import_crl - helper program for importing a crl to the NSS database
_import_crl is spawned by pluto in order to add or update a CRL in the NSS database (default: /var/lib/ipsec/nss)
Man page written for the Libreswan project <https://libreswan.org/> by Matt Rogers
